title: Windows AppContainer primitive qualification
objective: Prove on native Windows CI that Cotra can create a temporary AppContainer profile, derive its SID, and delete the profile without exposing process execution authority.

authority_delta.filesystem: Windows test creates and deletes only the per-user temporary AppContainer profile managed by the OS
authority_delta.process: No child process launch and no MCP execution authority

invariants: AppContainer profile names are validated before FFI
temporary profile is deleted on success
SID allocations returned by Windows are released with FreeSid
process.spawn remains policy-denied and absent from MCP
no network capability SID is granted

acceptance.claim: Windows native test creates an AppContainer profile successfully.
Windows native test derives the profile SID successfully.
Windows native test deletes the temporary profile successfully.
Non-Windows builds compile without linking Windows APIs.
Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu CI and Governance pass.

done_when: The AppContainer profile lifecycle is proven on Windows CI and merged with post-merge verification. Child launch remains a successor grain.
